tasks.md preamble, dated 2026-08-22 note under Group 1: the literal, named source of this node's acceptance criterion. Quoted verbatim: Residual RECORDED, deliberately not patched (host view staleness, root-caused 2026-08-22): the GM/host browser does not see an approved co-op proposal in its OWN campaign surfaces until a reload ... Root cause is the two-store split this change exists to remove, NOT a wiring gap ... A refetch would therefore return the stale record, and mirroring the broadcast into the host store would duplicate the guest mirror machinery that tasks 3.2-3.5 replace with the source/replica model. Fix it with those tasks (the host reads the same authoritative projection it publishes), not before.

design.md D9, GM view is a grant property, not a hosting property: The GM's full view comes from holding the all-scopes grant. Usually the GM hosts the source, but a GM connecting from another device gets a full-scope replica, same mechanism, no special path. This is the design-level instruction this node's title paraphrases: there is no bespoke host projection concept in the design; the host's own live view SHALL be produced by the SAME grant/projection mechanism used for every other viewer (D4), just with the all-scopes grant.

q4_theGap.statement: The host's own browser tab, despite receiving the full (GM all-scopes) committed event stream over the same campaign-sync transport guests use, never folds those events back into the useCampaignStore campaign object the rest of the host's dashboard reads. The guest branch of the exact same component performs this fold on every event (and once eagerly on mount) via a pure, already-generic projection function; the host branch only updates refusal/audit/pending UI state. Reconnect makes this worse: the host's transport connect call passes no cursor, so a disconnect-reconnect has no backfill mechanism even in principle. The persisted REST record (/api/campaigns/:id) that a naive refetch-based fix would reach for is independently confirmed stale for the same underlying reason (host commits bypass it), so read the projection, not a refetch (the node's without client substitution clause) is the only viable fix shape and matches D9's directive that the GM view is just another grant-scoped projection consumer.
twoDistinctReproductions: (a) Live: host approves/commits a co-op proposal (or the host itself, as sole player in a solo-hosted session, advances state) and the host's own dashboard does not reflect it until a manual reload, because the host effect's CampaignEvent handler never calls store.setState.

(b) Reconnect: a host that disconnects and reconnects (tab refresh, brief network loss) has no cursor threaded into the reconnect handshake, so events committed while disconnected are not backfilled into the host's view even after reconnect, unlike the guest path's lastSeq resume.
